connector.name: Standupbot
connector.registryDescription: Turns your GitHub activity into a daily standup - commits, PRs, reviews & issues.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package standupbot-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the rimysore account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
env.description: GitHub personal access token with read:user and repo scopes. Generate at https://github.com/settings/tokens
